free_tier: free, no key required; POST-only JSON API
known_limitations: POST-only: GET requests are not supported, so the generic JSON shape differs from other APIs
org_names matching is exact and case-sensitive-ish ('MEDTRONIC' and 'MEDTRONIC INC' return different sets; FY2023 with 'MEDTRONIC INC' returned 0)
the same award appears in several fiscal years; de-duplicate on core project number
award_notice_date is missing for some older records, leaving source_public_at unknown rather than guessed
rate_limits: no published hard number; keep offset/limit small (we used limit=2 and 1 req/s)
research_value: Direct evidence of US public money going to a firm's R&D; the award record carries an organisation field and an award-notice date, which makes both company attribution and a public-visibility clock deterministic.
